reviews.text: For over 25 years, this clinic has been perfect in every way: reception, attentive listening, diagnoses, and care. A huge thank you to its consistently professional team!

I highly recommend this vet. I've always been warmly welcomed and, most importantly, reassured about my cat. The vet takes the time to explain things, listens attentively, and truly cares about the animal's well-being.

I particularly appreciated his professionalism, gentleness, and the way he cared for my cat, even when I was worried. You can tell he loves his job and does everything he can to provide the best possible care for the animals.

Thank you for your professionalism and kindness. I will continue to come here without hesitation! 🐱❤️

I particularly appreciate the option of walk-in appointments in the afternoon, which significantly reduces my cat's stress. Nine times out of ten, this is the option I choose for him.

The reception is always attentive and personalized. The assistants are perfectly familiar with the names of the animals that need to be examined.

Finally, in the five years since I adopted my cat, I have developed a very valuable and trusting relationship with the three veterinarians at the clinic.

Hello,
We are delighted that you are satisfied with our veterinary services.
Our entire team is dedicated to providing professional and personalized care to each of our patients.
Thank you again for your trust and positive feedback.
Your veterinary team
A warm welcome, clear explanations, precise instructions, personalized follow-up for our sick Choupette – we found the perfect clinic for her care!

Hello,
Thank you so much for sharing your positive experience.
We are pleased that we were able to meet your pet's needs in the best possible way.
Your satisfaction is important to us, and we appreciate your recommendation.

Your Veterinary Team

Hello,
Thank you so much for your positive feedback.
Our priority is the health of your precious companion, and we are delighted to see your satisfaction.
Your veterinary team
Good vet, but the medications are extremely expensive. Bravecto 20-40kg sells for €60, versus €49 when ordered from the pharmacy a little further away. That's an €11 difference!
First visit after moving and I'm relieved to have this practice nearby. The team is very welcoming and the care is thorough.

Hello,
Your positive feedback means a lot to us.
Our dedicated team works tirelessly to ensure the well-being and good health of your animals.
Your support motivates us to continue providing quality care.

Your veterinary team

Hello,
Your trust and positive feedback towards our team mean a great deal to us.

We are delighted that our care was beneficial for your pet.

We remain available to provide you with convenient service and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team

Hello, I'm writing today to thank the clinic and the entire team for their support during the final moments of my beloved baby, Félie. Thank you for listening so attentively and for all your excellent advice. It was incredibly helpful. Thanks to you, Félie passed away peacefully; she's certainly happier than I am now. I will come back to see you when some time has passed. Thank you so much.

So I think my little Ciboulette would give it 0/5, especially after the injection he received for his own good, but as far as I'm concerned, the vets and assistants at the clinic deserve much more!

He was seen quickly and kindly. I also received excellent advice!

Thank you so much!!

I was traveling with my dog and needed guidance to continue our journey to London. The veterinarian was incredibly kind, patient, and supportive throughout the entire process. Even though we didn’t speak French, he took the time to understand us, explain everything clearly, and help us with all the necessary documentation.

I truly appreciate his professionalism and compassion. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who needs veterinary assistance, especially for international pet travel.

I brought my 15-year-old cat in as an absolute emergency; he was dying. While he was dying in his carrier, the assistant stubbornly clunked down on her computer, even asking me the cat's color instead of seeing me as an emergency. Faced with this absurdity and my distress, I told her I didn't care about the color; the urgent thing was to see the vet.

After the euthanasia, while I was fainting and having a panic attack, the vet took advantage of my extreme vulnerability to lecture me on the tone he used with his secretary. The priorities of this practice are sickening: money and protocol first, empathy never. I had to pay €200 on the spot for this disgraceful treatment.

Furthermore, be aware that the prices are exorbitant: the slightest procedure or examination, even a simple consultation to trim a nail or treat conjunctivitis, will automatically cost you €80.

Here, you will find only commercialism and dehumanization. If you love your pet and seek dignity during difficult times, avoid this practice.
competent staff

An abandoned, sick kitten found refuge at my workplace. They welcomed her with kindness and generosity, and I finally adopted her. They agreed to keep her for as long as I could—thank you! Even today, I call to give updates, and the welcome, even over the phone, is reassuring and lovely. I don't live in the neighborhood, but my Cookie won't go anywhere else 😌

Hello,
Thank you so much for your feedback!
Knowing that our work to provide the best possible care for your pet is appreciated motivates us even more.
Our team remains at your disposal to provide quality care and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team
Dr. Belais and his team are efficient, attentive, and provide a good prognosis. My cats are not stressed. I recommend them.

Excellent service. The vet was efficient, and the practice is very professional. I highly recommend them.
Thank you so much, Plume is doing great!
Nothing more to add… except… a 6th star!
Payment in four installments is possible.

A huge thank you for the exceptional reconstruction of the ligaments in my cat's hind leg. Thanks to this operation, he has regained full mobility and shows no signs of discomfort today. Well done and thank you to the whole team!

A warm welcome.
Dr. Belais is attentive, offers good advice, and is efficient and pragmatic.
Even my dog ​​feels at ease!

Hello,
Thank you for taking the time to leave us positive feedback.
It is our pleasure to care for the health of your pets.

Your veterinary team

I highly recommend this clinic! What touches me every time is the team's humanity: they don't just treat an "animal," they truly care for our companion as if it were their own. You can feel their passion, and it makes all the difference. The veterinarians are incredibly gentle; they take the time to reassure both the animal and the owner (which is often necessary!). We leave there with peace of mind, clear advice, and the feeling of having been truly listened to. Thank you for everything you do with such heart.
A very friendly, smiling, and highly professional team. I entrusted them with my cat for major surgery, and the surgeon literally saved her life. Thank you.
The vet listened and took his time, but prescribed medication... 2/3 medications were unnecessary.

Our cat had a major scare on the morning of February 10, 2026: bleeding from the mouth, drooling, tongue sticking out… We called the clinic in a bit of a panic and got an appointment just 45 minutes later. A huge thank you for this quick response, which allowed us to act swiftly and relieve his pain (extraction of a necrotic canine tooth).

The entire team, from reception to the veterinarian, was incredibly attentive, reassuring, and highly professional. We felt supported from beginning to end.

We recommend this clinic without hesitation!
I took my cat to the vet and everything went very well the same day, he ate well, the vet doctors and their team are professional.

HAPPY NEW YEAR TO THE WHOLE TEAM! 🥳🥳🥳🥳
THANK YOU TO DOCTOR SPITZ AND DOCTOR DEVILLEPOIX FOR THEIR KINDNESS AND EFFICIENCY.
OUR LITTLE SWEETIE IS GETTING BETTER AND BETTER! 😻😻😻😻😻
We were very satisfied with the welcome and the care.
Fantastic team, even with a cat that's not always easy. I highly recommend this clinic.

Appointment made the day before for the following day.
Very professional service.
The veterinarian was very empathetic and gentle with my old cat, who was able to pass away peacefully.
Thank you for being such a wonderful support during this difficult time.
My dog was bit on the street by another dog. She need to be seen right away. They took great care of my dog and fit us in right away. Very clean, organized and caring.

This so-called veterinarian would be better off working in a slaughterhouse. It's not a clinic anymore, it's a death trap! He killed one of my dogs a few years ago: I just happened to be there on the wrong day to get an X-ray! The dog had pyometra, a condition requiring emergency surgery… Three days wasted (and 600 euros, because when it comes to money, he doesn't lose face…): the little one ended up in terrible suffering because of this torturer who's only good for showing up at the slightest bit of media attention! And let's not even mention this sorry excuse for a man's behavior when he was president of the animal shelter. The scum of the profession.

I've taken my dog ​​to this clinic twice, and I've always been able to get an appointment the same day. The vets are very professional, attentive, and above all, very kind to my dog, who loves cuddles! After trying other clinics in the neighborhood, this is definitely our favorite.

Hello,
We appreciate your feedback on our veterinary services.
This encourages us to continue in this direction and to offer the best possible care for your pet.

Please know that your pet's health and well-being will always be our top priorities.

Your veterinary team

I was reassured by Dr. Belais's wise behavior in taking care of my little 16-year-old dog, and I was also very well received by his assistant. Fidji didn't cry. I paid the advertised price, and my little dog was doing very well when I picked her up. I recommend them.

Excellent service. I got an appointment immediately for my cat who was suffering from a dental infection. The vet was warm and helpful. I will definitely return for future appointments, which I hope won't be too frequent!

I've known Dr. Beslais for about thirty years. In the 18th arrondissement, he was the only vet who agreed to treat my daughter's little gerbil! Since then, he's naturally become the vet for my two dogs. The rest of his team is just as attentive and efficient. I recommend this veterinary practice wholeheartedly.
Our veterinarian Victoire showed tremendous responsiveness and extreme kindness.

The clinic offers walk-in appointments. This has its advantages (you can come in at the slightest doubt about your pet without having to find an appointment several days in advance), and its disadvantages (sometimes a bit of a wait). The team is professional, attentive to patients, friendly, and very kind to animals. Our cat, Prince, was diagnosed with diabetes, and we were able to be in daily contact with the veterinarian for almost two weeks to determine the correct insulin dosage. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!
Attentive, available, kind, very professional and efficient

A clinic of horrors! The vet was unfriendly and rough, and I couldn't even see where my cat was hospitalized (strange!!). They took him straight to a consultation room hooked up to an IV, and the receptionist was less than welcoming! Avoid at all costs.

Hello,
We are pleased to have been able to contribute positively to your pet's health. Your feedback encourages us to maintain this level of excellence.
We remain at your disposal should you have any questions or future veterinary needs.

Your Veterinary Team

A truly fantastic experience! The vet was wonderful with my cat, incredibly patient and gentle. She took all the time necessary to reassure me and answer my many questions. You can tell she genuinely loves animals. I'll definitely be back!

I had my little Siamese cat spayed, but they left pieces of her ovaries that are still producing hormones; she's urinating everywhere. They're asking me to treat her for 30 euros at least once a year—how cruel!
Excellent care was provided for my dog ​​who needed emergency surgery. The team took great care of the animal and listened attentively to my worried and stressed owner. Good job. I recommend them.

A very warm welcome, a consultation efficiently conducted by a doctor who knows his stuff. I think I actually prefer my old cat's regular vet to my own! In short, go there without hesitation; they're not crooks like so many in the area these days, nor are they butchers. Just a very good veterinary practice.

I will never set foot in that establishment again. I called in the morning to ask if a vet at their practice could treat exotic pets, and they told me yes, no problem. So I went in the afternoon, explained the situation, and waited to be seen by a vet. And then, the horror! The vet grabbed my rat without reassuring her at all; he snatched her in his hand, immobilized her suddenly, and she screamed like I've never heard her scream before, thrashed about, and even started bleeding from the nose! I have never seen a vet treat an animal like that; it's a disgrace. Avoid this place at all costs, at least for any exotic pet consultations. They have absolutely no consideration for these small, yet so fragile, animals.

I just moved, but I will continue to have my dogs treated at this clinic. Drs. Szpyt and Belais are skilled and know how to spend time with you when needed, finding the right words in very difficult situations. We lost a dog in an accident, and they and the whole team were there for us. They know how to ask the right questions and give clear advice. Four dogs have been treated there over the past three years, and I sleep soundly knowing they're healthy. :) The assistants welcome you with a smile and genuine warmth!

Thank you all!
Emmanuelle, Guillaume, Sonic, Carrie, Barnabé, and little angel Prosper

My dog ​​arrived at the clinic with a fever. The doctor, who was bleating, advised me to give her a good kick in the pants to shake things up. As a result, she had meningitis.

I do not recommend them, run away!! On top of that, they coldly took 2000 euros.

Hello,
Thank you so much for your positive review of our veterinary clinic.
Providing a calming environment and high-quality care for your pet is our priority.
Thank you again for your trust.
Your veterinary team

A perfect practice, from Dr. Bêlais to the assistants, including Dr. Julien. Our Apollon was hit by a car, and the entire team mobilized to take care of him quickly; X-rays, surgery,

in 3 days we were relieved to see Apollon slowly recovering.

A huge thank you to Dr. Bêlais.

Hello,
We are delighted that you are satisfied with our veterinary services.
Our entire team is dedicated to providing professional and personalized care to each of our patients.
Thank you again for your trust and positive feedback.
Your veterinary team
Very kind and efficient, thank you to the whole team.
Very good welcome, a little expensive, but Mr. BELAIS the veterinarian listens to you and is a true PROFESSIONAL, a big thank you to him and the team, I recommend.
My pet had a skin problem. The vet talked to me about surgery when a cream was enough to cure it. Luckily, I consulted other vets to avoid this unnecessary procedure.
This clinic, which I wasn't familiar with, is highly recommended to all pet owners. I am delighted with their competence and kindness.

A huge thank you to the wonderful team at the clinic! Their kindness, their smiles, and their ability to make you feel comfortable from the moment you arrive make all the difference.

During my first visit, Dr. Belais quickly identified that my little rabbit, Poupi, was suffering from conjunctivitis. He took the time to carefully observe Poupi and gave me excellent advice.

When I returned because Poupi's condition was worsening, he diagnosed exophthalmos with great accuracy. Thanks to his responsiveness and recommendations, I was quickly referred to a specialist who took care of my precious companion.

Poupi will be hospitalized starting Thursday, and I know that he will now have nothing but a wonderful recovery thanks to the combined efforts of all these marvelous professionals.

Furthermore, the clinic is accessible without an appointment, which is a huge plus in emergencies.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a warm welcome and impeccable care for their pets. Thank you again to the entire team for everything you've done for Poupi and me!

Mathilde

A clinic I've known for several years, but which I no longer have the pleasure of visiting since I moved. But when I'm traveling, like today, that's where I go. So I went there with my young dog, and as usual, we received a wonderfully warm welcome. There's such dedication to animals. It's heartwarming. In any case, my dog ​​was cared for with gentleness and kindness. A big thank you.
An excellent clinic, whether for serious emergencies or routine medical follow-up. We are always welcomed with great kindness and care. Thank you to the entire team!
Excellent and very understanding welcome; I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Paris Damrémont Veterinary Clinic, who saved my little dog Lou's life during an extremely delicate operation. Lou spent a whole week at this clinic, where she was pampered and surrounded by care. …

Your positive feedback means a lot to us.
Our dedicated team works tirelessly to ensure the well-being and good health of … More

My pet received excellent care from the very first call to schedule the appointment. The receptionist, Fanny, is very professional, friendly, and welcoming. I highly recommend Dr. Belais; he is very efficient and attentive. He demonstrated …

I would like to thank the clinic again for their welcome. Tabou gave us a real fright. We came in as an emergency and were seen very quickly. He recovered rapidly after swallowing something nasty. Thank you for your efficiency and kindness, and thank you to your entire team.
Very warm welcome, patience and gentleness with my dog ​​and me.
Thank you to Dr. Belais for his professionalism and attentiveness, and to the entire team for caring for our cat, Douchka, for five years. …
